name: Rogelio "Roger" Bañuelos
office: Wiseburn Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Rogelio "Roger" Bañuelos is president of the Wiseburn Unified School District Board of Trustees, serving since 2009. He is also president of Element Consulting, a construction management company dedicated to improving learning environments for students in the education sector. He has been a board member for Da Vinci Schools and the Wiseburn Education Foundation, and a board member representative for the Los Angeles County School Trustees Association. His company profile says he is an original founder of Da Vinci Schools. He has voiced support for a performing arts program spanning transitional kindergarten through high school.
